frozen_site_definition.coordinate_mapping: Map each of the ordered 85 KLIFS residues to the selected reviewed UniProt canonical core kinase domain, then to the exact canonical AlphaFold or admitted apo entity. Require a unique monotonic residue-level mapping and exact amino-acid agreement at all retained positions; an aggregate LCS score alone cannot admit coordinates.
frozen_site_definition.reference_domain: reviewed human UniProt canonical wild-type core kinase domain

forbidden: silent collapse of mutants, phosphorylation states, or binding-partner constructs

pocket_feature_contract.atom_policy: protein atoms only after residue mapping; deterministic alternate-location resolution; model 1
pocket_feature_contract.geometry: rigid-motion invariant residue/atom chemistry, shape, and distance/contact summaries
pocket_feature_contract.missingness: missing-position indicators are explicit; primary predicted view requires 85/85 mapped residues

receptor_view_roles.holo: forbidden in primary; separately labeled sensitivity only and never site-defining

structural_leakage_edges.current_edges: same KLIFS family OR aligned KLIFS85 sequence identity >=0.70
structural_leakage_edges.coordinate_edge_addition: US-align pocket TM-score >=0.75 OR Foldseek pocket E-value <=1e-5
structural_leakage_edges.edge_union: transitive closure; coordinate edges may merge but never split current components
